summary.headline: Zodiac Signs and Seasonal Qualities
summary.text: Astrological explanation of the zodiac’s bodily correspondences, beginning with Aries as the head and Taurus as the neck, and of the four ages assigned to the four seasons. The signs are classified as tropical, solid, and bicorporeal, with Aries through Virgo used to describe seasonal changes in the air, daylight, and night.
